text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh. Preparing for tomorrow's race, are we?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile! Welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Gentildonna-san. Beautiful, cool, and my 
dependable roommate.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Tonight, we're staying at a hotel over 
there."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...That's a lot of luggage for that, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So right now, I'm carefully 
mulling it over...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Shampoo, skincare stuff... something to 
pass the time on the Shinkansen. Before I 
knew it, my bag was stuffed full—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. ...You certainly seem relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho... The first crown of the 
Triple Tiara route. It is a truly vital 
race that heralds the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ? Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm really looking forward to 
it! Everyone's expecting so much from me, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best so I can live up to 
everyone's hopes and feelings!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In that case, may I also hold 
high expectations?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"As a senior on the Tiara route, would you 
show me what it means to lead by example?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll carry those expectations with me 
too...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oka Sho. As far as 
objective races go, we hadn't been back to 
Hanshin Racecourse since the Hanshin 
Juvenile Fillies.
choice_data_list:
(I'm so glad it arrived properly this 
time...)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah...! It's Buena Vista!
choice_data_list: （今回はちゃんとついてよかった……）
choice_data_list_en: (I'm glad it lit up properly this time...)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I came to cheer for you today! Do your 
best~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In no time at all, fans begin gathering 
around Buena Vista... Part of it is likely 
how high-profile the race itself is, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much! I'll do my 
absolute best to live up to your 
expectations, so—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Please be sure to cheer for me during the 
race as well!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Do your best~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—We got such huge cheers. We've gotta 
give it our all!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her all fired up, a touch of 
anxiety crossed my mind. It happened 
during the "Discipline-Specific 
Competition" she ran in prior to our 
formal contract—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I just realized. You've been pretty 
nervous, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her rich sensitivity, swept up in the 
crowd's fervor... she had gotten 
completely stiff with tension.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's energy today is greater than 
ever. Even if she seemed fine up until 
now... she might be feeling nervous 
without even realizing it.
choice_data_list: Buena... How about we take a deep breath?
Buena... Wanna take a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list_en: Buena... Want to take a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, you're right. Please do!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I call out to Buena Vista to help her 
focus, and urge her to take a deep 
breath...
choice_data_list: よし、じゃあ……目を閉じて
choice_data_list_en: All right, now... close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Your voice really is... so calming 
after all."
choice_data_list: 大丈夫。君なら……今日の主役になれる
大丈夫。貴方なら……今日の主役になれる
choice_data_list_en: Don't worry. If anyone can be today's star, it's you.
Don't worry. If anyone can be today's star, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you, I'm fine now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first crown of the Triple Tiara 
route... If it's Buena Vista, she can 
stand at the very center of this year's 
Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san. I have been eagerly waiting 
for today, when I could face you head-on."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for keeping that in mind. I 
was looking forward to this too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, that sun-like brilliance. That is 
precisely why... I must surpass it."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —As a “Saint.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, be my partner. So that my story 
may begin...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan's story...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—You look like you're having so much fun! 
Thanks for letting me join in.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have no intention of losing. 
Because there are people waiting for my 
story!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin, Desire-chan! On the Tiara's 
stage—let's shine as bright as we can!
